class Mentor:
    def __init__(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        self._student = None

    def setName(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        return True

    def getName(self):
        return self._name

    def getStudent(self):
        return self._student

    def hasStudent(self):
        return self._student is not None

    def setStudent(self, aStudent):
        existingStudent = self._student
        if existingStudent is None:
            if aStudent is None or not aStudent.addMentor(self):
                return False
        else:
            if existingStudent.numberOfMentors() <= existingStudent.minimumNumberOfMentors():
                return False
            existingStudent.removeMentor(self)
            if aStudent is not None:
                aStudent.addMentor(self)
        self._student = aStudent
        return True

    def delete(self):
        if self._student is not None:
            if self._student.numberOfMentors() <= 1:
                self._student.delete()
            else:
                placeholderStudent = self._student
                self._student = None
                placeholderStudent.removeMentor(self)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "name:" + str(self.getName())
                + "]"
                + "\n  student = " + ("null" if self.getStudent() is None else format(id(self.getStudent()), "x")))
